form.label: Audit Package
form.description: Review a fixed, exportable assessment snapshot with scope, framework versions, evidence, and remediation.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected_value=tostring(coalesce(selected,default_selected)), selected=if(selected_value="1" OR selected_value="true",1,0) | search status=active selected=1 | fields framework_key framework_name
| inputlookup ccp_scopes | search status=active | sort scope_name | fields scope_key scope_name

div.p: Use the tables below as the package index. Export each table from Splunk after confirming the framework versions, scope, period, and evidence review status.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected_value=tostring(coalesce(selected,default_selected)), selected=if(selected_value="1" OR selected_value="true",1,0) | search status=active selected=1 | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | table framework_name framework_key version authority content_digest source_url | rename framework_name as Framework framework_key as "Framework key" version as Version authority as Authority content_digest as "Content digest" source_url as "Source reference"

html.div:
Scope: $scope_token$
Period: $package_earliest$ through $package_latest$
Interpretation: Not assessed, stale evidence, expired evidence, unresolved findings, and risk acceptance remain visible in the export.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_assessment_profiles.csv | lookup framework_catalog.csv framework_key OUTPUT framework_name version | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | table framework_name version assessment_granularity assessment_methods scoring_model required_artifacts audit_boundary | rename framework_name as Framework version as Version assessment_granularity as "Assessment level" assessment_methods as "Assessment methods" scoring_model as "Decision model" required_artifacts as "Artifacts expected" audit_boundary as "Audit boundary"

| makeresults | eval package_id="ccp-" . strftime(now(),"%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"), generated_at=strftime(now(),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), framework_filter="$framework_token$", scope_filter="$scope_token$", period_start="$package_earliest$", period_end="$package_latest$" | appendcols [| `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | stats count as requirement_count] | appendcols [| inputlookup ccp_assessments | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats count as assessment_count] | appendcols [| inputlookup ccp_evidence | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats count as evidence_count] | appendcols [| inputlookup ccp_findings | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | stats count as finding_count] | eval requirement_count=coalesce(requirement_count,0), assessment_count=coalesce(assessment_count,0), evidence_count=coalesce(evidence_count,0), finding_count=coalesce(finding_count,0), export_status="Ready for table export" | table package_id generated_at framework_filter scope_filter period_start period_end requirement_count assessment_count evidence_count finding_count export_status | rename package_id as "Package ID" generated_at as "Generated at" framework_filter as Framework scope_filter as Scope period_start as "Period start" period_end as "Period end" requirement_count as Requirements assessment_count as Assessments evidence_count as Evidence finding_count as Findings export_status as Status

html.div: Export contract: export this manifest together with the framework register, requirement assessment register, measurement register, evidence register, and remediation register. The package ID, framework content digests, scope, and period must remain together.

search.query: | `ccp_selected_requirements` | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | lookup ccp_framework_catalog framework_key OUTPUT version content_digest | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| inputlookup ccp_assessments | eval assessed_epoch=strptime(assessed_at,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), period_start=relative_time(now(),"$package_earliest$"), period_end=if("$package_latest$"="now",now(),relative_time(now(),"$package_latest$")) | where assessed_epoch>=period_start AND assessed_epoch<=period_end | where "$scope_token$"="*" OR scope_key="$scope_token$" | sort 0 - assessed_at | dedup framework_key requirement_key scope_key system_key | stats latest(scope_key) as assessment_scope latest(status) as status latest(score) as score latest(assessor) as assessor latest(assessed_at) as assessed_at latest(reviewer) as reviewer latest(reviewed_at) as reviewed_at latest(valid_until) as valid_until latest(exception_reference) as exception_reference by framework_key requirement_key] | join type=left framework_key requirement_key [| inputlookup ccp_evidence | eval collected_epoch=strptime(collected_at,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), period_start=relative_time(now(),"$package_earliest$"), period_end=if("$package_latest$"="now",now(),relative_time(now(),"$package_latest$")) | where collected_epoch>=period_start AND collected_epoch<=period_end | where "$scope_token$"="*" OR scope_key="$scope_token$" | stats count as evidence_count latest(status) as evidence_status latest(collected_at) as collected_at latest(expires_at) as expires_at latest(review_due_at) as review_due_at by framework_key requirement_key] | eval result_status=if(isnull(status),"Not assessed",status), evidence_count=coalesce(evidence_count,0) | table framework_name framework_key version content_digest requirement_key title canonical_control_name mapping_status result_status assessment_scope score assessor assessed_at reviewer reviewed_at valid_until exception_reference evidence_count evidence_status collected_at expires_at review_due_at | rename framework_name as Framework framework_key as "Framework key" version as Version content_digest as "Content digest" requirement_key as "Check key" title as Requirement canonical_control_name as "Canonical control" mapping_status as "Mapping status" result_status as Status assessment_scope as Scope score as Score assessor as Assessor assessed_at as "Assessed at" reviewer as Reviewer reviewed_at as "Reviewed at" valid_until as "Valid until" exception_reference as Exception evidence_count as Evidence evidence_status as "Evidence status" collected_at as "Collected at" expires_at as "Evidence expires" review_due_at as "Evidence review due"

| `ccp_measurement_rollup` | eval period_start=relative_time(now(),"$package_earliest$"), period_end=if("$package_latest$"="now",now(),relative_time(now(),"$package_latest$")), measured_epoch=strptime(measured_at,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where measured_epoch>=period_start AND measured_epoch<=period_end | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | table result_key scope_key framework_key framework_version requirement_key measurement_key adapter_key status observed_value expected_value measured_at source evidence_key limitations measurement_origin | rename result_key as "Result key" scope_key as Scope framework_key as Framework framework_version as Version requirement_key as "Check key" measurement_key as Measurement adapter_key as Adapter status as Status observed_value as Observed expected_value as Expected measured_at as "Measured at" source as Source evidence_key as Evidence limitations as Limitations measurement_origin as Origin

| inputlookup ccp_evidence | eval period_start=relative_time(now(),"$package_earliest$"), period_end=if("$package_latest$"="now",now(),relative_time(now(),"$package_latest$")), collected_epoch=strptime(collected_at,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where collected_epoch>=period_start AND collected_epoch<=period_end | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | table system_key scope_key framework_key framework_version requirement_key evidence_type title owner collected_by source_type status collected_at review_due_at expires_at reviewed_by reviewed_at acceptance_notes location | rename system_key as System scope_key as Scope framework_key as Framework framework_version as Version requirement_key as "Check key" evidence_type as Type title as Evidence owner as Owner collected_by as Collector source_type as Source status as Status collected_at as "Collected at" review_due_at as "Review due" expires_at as Expires reviewed_by as Reviewer reviewed_at as "Reviewed at" acceptance_notes as "Acceptance notes" location as Reference

| inputlookup ccp_findings | eval period_start=relative_time(now(),"$package_earliest$"), period_end=if("$package_latest$"="now",now(),relative_time(now(),"$package_latest$")), updated_epoch=strptime(updated_at,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where updated_epoch>=period_start AND updated_epoch<=period_end | search framework_key="$framework_token$" OR "$framework_token$"="*" | search scope_key="$scope_token$" OR "$scope_token$"="*" | table finding_key scope_key framework_key framework_version requirement_key title severity status owner due_at remediation exception_reference retest_at closed_at | rename finding_key as "Finding key" scope_key as Scope framework_key as Framework framework_version as Version requirement_key as "Check key" title as Finding severity as Severity status as Status owner as Owner due_at as Due remediation as Remediation exception_reference as Exception retest_at as Retest closed_at as Closed
